Name: Robin Williams Plays Linus - CP Character Mod
Author: SterlingDraven
Description:
[left][b][size=4][b][size=4][/size][/b][/size][/b][/left][left][b][size=4][b][size=4][/size][/b][/size][/b][/left][center][left][b][b][size=4][/size][/b][/b][/left][/center][center][left][b][b][size=4][/size][/b][/b][/left][/center][center][left][b][b][size=4][/size][/b][/b][/left][/center][center][/center][center][/center][center]﻿[b][b][size=4]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zo7Olwg.png[/img][/size][/b]
[size=4]What year is it?![/size]﻿﻿
[size=2]
[/size][/b][size=2]When I first started playing in 2018 and met Linus for the first time, my immediate thought was, "A tribute to Robin Williams??" I never did find the answer to that, but what I did find was a fast friend that will always remind me that often, the most important things in life really are the simplest.[/size]

[size=2]In short, this mod will restyle Linus' Character and Portrait files to look like none other than the one and only Robin Williams, as his character Alan Parrish (aged just a bit, for continuity) in the 1995 classic film, [/size][i]Jumanji[/i][size=2].[/size]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/T9VlB8I.png[/img]﻿
[size=4][b][i]You're only given a little spark of madness. You mustn't lose it.
[/i][/b][i]~ Robin Williams[/i]
[/size]
[size=2]I thought it was incredibly strange that, despite all the love and the numerous mods revolving around our sweet, dumpster-diving raccoon-man, not one even seemed to reference the obvious resemblance. So, after getting myself absurdly lost on r/StardewValley, I stumbled upon [/size][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/m6anzc/i_thought_linus_looked_familiar/][color=#e69138]this post[/color][/url][color=#bf9000]﻿[/color][size=2]. I finally worked up the coffee and the courage, and set about making my very first public mod, [i]ever [/i]: [/size][s]one to rule them all...[/s][size=2] Sorry! Wrong movie![/size]
[size=2]﻿[/size]

[b][color=#ffd966]Installation:[/color][/b]
[size=2][b]-[/b] Download and unzip mod to ~\Stardew Valley\Mods
[b]-[/b] Run game and enjoy!


[/size][b][color=#ffd966]Bugs and other issues:[/color][/b][size=2]
Hopefully, with Content Patcher, nothing should go wrong. But if it does, leave a message in Posts, and I'll do my best to resolve any errors.
[/size]
